channel.title: Pier & Point · P10
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for P10 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · P10: Mission Bay P10 now records the Assessor lots it overlaps.
item.description: Mission Bay P10 now records the Assessor lots it overlaps. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8709003.

item.title: Correction · P10: The record's text says Pier & Point, not 'the owner', where it names who read or chose the Assessor lots.
item.description: The record's text says Pier & Point, not 'the owner', where it names who read or chose the Assessor lots.

item.title: Correction · P10: The record's 2010 under-construction milestone had no year in its source (EPA's July 2012 fact sheet), so it became a fact about the $760,000 subgrant. The November 2011 milestone had read the press tour as showing the circle not yet functional; EPA's advisory for that tour celebrates the completion of Mission Bay Drive and Circle, so the status was removed. The September 2023 open-space deck says RPD 'will manage' P10 rather than already managing it. A citation to our own mapping notes was replaced by the Dec 2019 land use map, the Bay Crossings article is dated December 2011, the map shape now cites its sources, and the aerial photo caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'.
item.description: The record's 2010 under-construction milestone had no year in its source (EPA's July 2012 fact sheet), so it became a fact about the $760,000 subgrant. The November 2011 milestone had read the press tour as showing the circle not yet functional; EPA's advisory for that tour celebrates the completion of Mission Bay Drive and Circle, so the status was removed. The September 2023 open-space deck says RPD 'will manage' P10 rather than already managing it. A citation to our own mapping notes was replaced by the Dec 2019 land use map, the Bay Crossings article is dated December 2011, the map shape now cites its sources, and the aerial photo caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'. item.title: Complete · P10: OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation to the Mission Bay CAC (September 2023) lists P10 among the parcels RPD 'will manage' (transfer by the end of December 2023), not among the parcels listed as 'when built' -- an upper bound on when this island was built, not its actual construction date (~2023)

item.title: Milestone · P10: EPA's November 4, 2011 media advisory announces a tour of Mission Bay 'to celebrate the completion of Mission Bay Drive and Circle'; Bay Crossings (Dec 2011) reports guests got 'a first peek at Mission Bay Circle, a landscaped turnaround that will eventually serve as a gateway to the park corridor'. Neither source separately dates the P10 island itself (~2011)
